capabilities: Write created, completion and cancelled timestamps when task state changes
Define custom intermediate task states that cycle on click
Configure per-state format templates with a {{time}} placeholder
Suggest a created-time field while typing in a task line
Restrict interception and transitions to tasks with a trigger tag
disambiguation: A fork of Obsidian Tasks focused only on timestamp writing and custom state cycling, not full task management features like recurring tasks or queries.
extras: Installation is manual via GitHub release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css) rather than only through the community plugin store; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin is derived from the open-source project Obsidian Tasks
problem: Obsidian tasks lack automatic timestamp fields (created, completion, cancelled) written on state changes, and support only limited built-in task states.

relations.evidence: This plugin is derived from the open-source project Obsidian Tasks, keeping the task timestamp write/remove approach

summary: Task timestamp plugin that automatically writes created, completion and cancelled timestamps with custom state transitions and configurable format templates.
